description: Sets a clip's Motion Position property (x,y or a value array).

sequenceId.description: Target sequence id; active sequence if omitted.

value.description: Explicit value overriding x/y; else falls back to amount.

x.description: X position; combined with y into [x,y] if value not given.

y.description: Y position; combined with x into [x,y].

name: set_clip_position
